motivation: E01 A2 and E10/E11 A1 raw fixed patches visibly contain an oblique train of broad spots crossing science trace. Quantify spatial trajectory using off-trace pixels away from saved hit.
training: Exclude all rows within80 raw pixels of candidate row, and every pixel within6 columns of every predicted main A or B trace. Use retained highpass image from fixed31-row median filter.

grid.score: Mean signed highpass ADU within strip on unmasked training pixels. All candidate line hypotheses retained; no empirical p-value.

evaluation: At the withheld candidate row, compare fitted ridge center to predicted science center; plot ridge and training exclusion. Reflected spectrum parent order and exact wavelength-transfer function remain unidentified.
limitations: Chosen after seeing an oblique structure; optimized scores are descriptive and cannot supply significance. Header trace models may have subpixel errors. Sparse ghost plus particles can perturb fitted trajectory.
reason: First unconstrained average-strip maximum for E01 used only one unmasked pixel and cannot identify a trajectory. Preserve original full grids and require broad two-sided support for both targets.
